title: fix(hub): record a readable error on a failed Do
body:
A failed Do stored the raw transport line (method, path, status), which the pane then showed under the action group. The row and the 502 response now carry the same sentence the per-kind action route returns, through one shared helper used by both routes; the raw line stays in the structured log.

Verified: `bun run check`; hub tests, with the spawned-hub Do case where GitHub answers 422 asserting the plain sentence on both the response and the listed row.

Refs CL-XXXX
author: TheGreatAxios
commits: fix(hub): record a readable error on a failed Do
